items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: I got permission to redo this thing that Paul Gaten did because I felt that I could do more with it than what he had going.

ctx.x: alone to give the other fellas an idea.

Yeah. Well that's mostly music energy. We call it arranging. Yeah. You prepare these things in your mind. Yeah. And be writing them down. And we had to do them by air. Yeah. You know. Yeah. Memorize. I slept with that group quite a little, a little while I see. So we was really the one to bring, uh, uh, She Ain't Got No Hair and Bald Head, Mardi Gras New Orleans. Did you cut any other records around that time? He Ain't Our Baby, Ain't Our Honey Child with them. Yeah with them. I got permission to redo this thing…
Did you, uh, was this all on, uh, Aladdin and Imperial, or? Yeah. So many different labels.
